authoredNote: Source written first from the whole-population finding; lines are from `nl -ba` of THIS file: WithComment 15, Sub 19, the error-recovery interface 22-23, the JSX fragment 25.
rationale: PINS THE TARGETLESS-EDGE CLASS AND THE COMMENT-AS-NAME DEFECT, in both directions. The gate started disclosing edges whose target names NOTHING (its `noTarget` class) — 1 references + 1 extends across 13,950 admitted files. Root causes, both measured on the population: (1) `comment` and `ERROR` are NAMED CHILDREN of heritage clauses in this grammar, and the extractor published every named child's TEXT as an extends/implements target — so a comment became a target (`extends WithComment -> "/* note */"`) and a zero-width comment became an EMPTY one (pixie react-table-config.d.ts); (2) a JSX fragment inside a `.ts` file (error recovery inserts a zero-width MISSING type_identifier) produced a `references`/cast_target row with an empty target (redwood exports.ts fixture). A target that names nothing is not a weaker claim — it is not a relationship. THE POSITIVES prove the real bases still publish; the FORBIDS make both defects red if they return. NOTE ON THE JSX-FRAGMENT HALF: `fragmentInTs` is deliberately NOT an expected symbol — the fragment makes the initializer unparseable in a `.ts` file, so the analyzer publishes no symbol for it (that is the error-recovery reality); the fixture pins the ABSENCE of the empty-target references row, which is what matters.
